identity.name: Merrick Square
identity.notes: Gated D.R. Horton townhome community of approximately 211 two-story units across 4 floor plans (1,738–1,962 sq ft, 3–4 bedrooms, 2.5–3 baths, 1-car garage), located off 172nd Avenue just south of Pines Boulevard in Pembroke Pines, FL 33027. New construction priced in the mid-$600K to low-$800K range. HOA managed by RealManage (C/O 11784 West Sample Road, Coral Springs, FL 33065; resident support 1-866-473-2573); a Community Development District (CDD) established in 2021 works alongside the HOA to manage common areas and improvements.

fees.note: Reported in various sources as approximately $135–$240/month (often $150–$182), covering common area maintenance, gated entry, clubhouse, pool, fitness center, and tot lot (lawn maintenance included in some descriptions). Exact current fees, transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments are not publicly available. HOA association ID N21000014314; managed by RealManage (no community-specific public phone/email found). Detailed architectural, landscaping, parking, pet, rental, noise, and trash rules not publicly detailed. The HOA's own website (merricksquarehoa.com) is currently suspended. Confidence: 0.6, retrieved_at: 2025-06-01T12:00:00Z
CDD established 2021; works alongside HOA to manage common areas and improvements. Assessment amounts not publicly available. Confidence: 0.5, retrieved_at: 2025-06-01T12:00:00Z

Buyer guide states HOA runs approximately $150/month; covers common areas, gated entry system, clubhouse, swimming pool, fitness center, and tot lot. Does NOT cover interior maintenance, unit insurance, or utilities. Fees may adjust as reserves build in this new community. Verify with HOA (RealManage). Conflicting figure: median listed fee $182/mo (see separate fact). Pet policy and rental restrictions not stated in source; check HOA docs before closing. Confidence 0.6 (reputable listing/broker site, not official HOA). Retrieved 2026-10-10T12:00:00Z (approx).

Median monthly-equivalent HOA fee across 5 active Merrick Square listings with a usable fee, per PBP Real Estate's daily analysis of BeachesMLS data as of October 10, 2026. 25% below the Pembroke Pines townhouse/villa median of $244/mo. Broker-entered MLS data, not an official HOA figure; small sample (5 listings). 0 of 5 listings mention a special assessment in public remarks. Confidence 0.6 (reputable MLS-data site, not official HOA). Retrieved 2026-10-10T12:00:00Z (approx).

Merrick Square CDD is a special-purpose government entity established October 20, 2021 by Pembroke Pines City Commission Ordinance No. 1976; its Board may levy taxes, special assessments, fees, and user charges for district facilities. Specific per-parcel annual CDD tax/assessment amount NOT verified on this page. An FY2025 adopted budget with an Assessment Summary is published at emma.msrb.org/P21994084.pdf (not read). Confidence 0.8 (official CDD site) for existence/authority; amount unknown. Retrieved 2026-10-10T12:00:00Z (approx).
